cohort: 92 women with a mean age of 32.7 years who underwent uncomplicated vaginal delivery or cesarean section
finding: A significant increase in uterine artery resistance index (RI) was observed from 2 to 24 hours following uncomplicated delivery, while transient pelvic free fluid effusion was exceedingly rare.
mod_finding: Twenty-four hours after vaginal delivery, endometrial and anterior wall thicknesses dropped and uterine width increased, but no changes in uterine length and posterior wall thickness were observed between 2 and 24 hours after delivery.
